package app

class Base {
  def baseCall: Int = 1
  def neverCalled: Int = 2
}

trait Greets {
  def greet: Int = 3
  def silent: Int = 4
}

class Derived extends Base with Greets {
  def go(p: Int): Int = {
    val local = 1
    if (flag) baseCall + greet + p + local else 0
  }
  def flag: Boolean = true
}

object Cli {
  def main(args: Array[String]): Unit = {
    println(new Derived().go(1))
  }
}

object Unused {
  def helper: Int = 5
}
